blockers.summary: Working tree on /sessions/<sandbox>/mnt/mapsly has crashed-session leftovers (.git-rewrite/, .git/index.lock, _tmp_3_*) and local main has no commits. FUSE mount blocks unlink() — recovery is host-only.
blockers.recipe: cd ~/Documents/Claude/Projects/mapsly && rm -rf .git-rewrite/ _tmp_3_* .claude/memory/_test-tick.txt && rm -f .git/index.lock && git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main

notes: First tick of the day's window. Found the loop in an unrecoverable state from inside the sandbox. INC-14 documents why INC-01's GIT_DIR=/tmp trick is insufficient — unlink is blocked on the working tree itself, not just on .git lockfiles.
